title: Surfaces with parallel mean curvature in warped product spaces
summary: In this work, we obtain a geometric description of surfaces $M^2$ of arbitrary codimension in the warped product $\mathbb{R}\times_ρ\mathbb{Q}^n_ε$, with parallel mean curvature vector field in the normal connection, extending a result by Alencar-do Carmo-Tribuzy.
